notes.title: Game Release
notes.content:
[h3]The game has ended its Early Access and will be released in the full version on March 11th[/h3]
[list]
[*] All levels, puzzles, codes, and hints have been fully and meticulously updated and completed in the game.
[*] Optimized performance for PC, fixed any image and sound conflicts, and improved loading times for each level.
Players can enable all settings in Ultra mode for the best experience.
[*] The game price will remain the same after the end of the Early Access phase.
You can purchase the game at any time or wishlist and wait for upcoming discounts.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425014/df5bd3213c8f6fcb4a072c199d9387bf68c043fc.png[/img]

[i]Thank you very much to the players who have accompanied the game during the Early Access phase.[/i]

notes.title: Updated more Hints for the game
notes.content:
[h1]Updated more Hints for the game[/h1]

[h2]Fixed some interface and image issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Optimized the game better for low-end machines, you can turn on Ultra for higher quality graphics.
[*] The game has been updated with many more Hints so that everyone can play, the difficulty of the puzzles remains the same if the player does not view the Hints.
[*] Hints are now simpler, easier to understand, and some may reveal the answers.
[*] Players can use Hints unlimitedly, but if you want to experience the perfect game, please consider it.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425014/40884ea17588346e4316676ed0877d0f0bbb6110.png[/img]

[i]This update does not apply to the Demo version, so the difficulty level of the Demo version will remain high even if Hints are used.[/i]

notes.title: Completed the second level
notes.content:
[h2]Completed the second level[/h2]

[list]
[*] This is the 2nd out of 3 levels
[*] New images have been updated on the Steam store page.

[b]Bonus:[/b] 2023 is the year of the cat in Vietnam.
